texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。轮回之终末在我们[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]系中具现化了一颗盖亚星球，为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]提供了一片理想家园；这是一个用来拥抱万物终结的转瞬即逝的乐园。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The End of the Cycle has materialized a Gaia World in our [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleeting paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。轮回之终末已经在[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]系中显现了一艘全新的方舟舰，其上载满了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]；这是一艘飞驰的天堂之船，用以拥抱万物的终结。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The End of the Cycle has materialized a new Arkship teeming with [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind in the [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system; a fleeting vessel of paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.
